title: Conjunction Voltage
summary: Conjunction Voltage is an Arcane Enhancement for secondary weapons that increases secondary weapon reload speed and multishot for 12 seconds when applying  Electricity procs.
extract:
Conjunction Voltage is an Arcane Enhancement for secondary weapons that increases secondary weapon reload speed and multishot for 12 seconds when applying  Electricity procs.

Effect

Acquisition
Conjunction Voltage can be obtained from Conjunction Survival Circulus on Lua as a Rotation B reward.
Purchaseable from Archimedean Yonta in the Zariman for 15  Lua Thrax Plasm each, with a total of 315 for max rank.
Possible reward from Deepmines Bounties from Nightcap.
Purchaseable from Nightcap in Fortuna for 10  Fergolyte each, with a total of 210 for max rank.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Note
At all ranks, it will take 40  Electricity procs to reach the maximum effect, which is 120% Multishot and 60% reload speed at Rank 5.
Stacking the Voltage buff does not require the  Electricity proc to come from the attached secondary weapon, and can stack even while the secondary is holstered. Sources include:
Any weapon with modded or innate  Electricity damage and status chance
Warframes with abilities that directly inflict  Electricity status effects, such as  Gyre,  Vauban,  Volt, and  Wisp
Warframes with  Electricity moddable Exalted Weapons, such as  Mesa,  Titania,  Jade,  Dante and  Hildryn, plus others
Warfarmes which have received subsume abilities from the Helminth that can inflict  Electricity including:
 Coil Horizon from  Gyre
 Tesla Nervos from  Vauban
 Shock from  Volt
Warframes with abilities that apply many status effects, such as  Citrine,  Koumei and  Voruna
Warframes with variable-element configurations, such as  Lavos and  Chroma
Warframes that make  Electricity-inflicting traps, such as  Follie, and  Mirage
Companion Weapons that deal  Electricity elemental damage via mods like  Shocking Claws and  Shock Collar
 Diriga's  Electricity procs from precept mods  Arc Coil and  Electro Pulse
Hounds equipped with  Synergized Prospectus mod will produce a bouncing orb that continually inflicts  Electricity.
Though some enemies have a capped number of status effects they can receive, such as Bosses and Adversaries, applying an  Electricity proc to an enemy at max procs will still cause Voltage to refresh and stack.
Stacks are granted and refreshed even on fatal damage instances that apply  Electricity.
 Electricity procs that are created by  Magnetic status do not give stacks.
 Lightning Dash does not stack Voltage, despite inflicting a  Electricity status proc.
If the 12 second timer expires without applying a fresh  Electricity status effect, all stacks are removed.
This behavior is consistent with other weapon arcanes that trigger on status effect application, like  Cascadia Flare and  Primary Blight.
This is distinct from weapon arcanes that trigger on kill, like  Secondary Merciless and  Secondary Deadhead, where timer expiration causes only one stack to be removed at a time.

Tips
With high fire rate weapons such as  Afuris,  Regulators, or  Quatz, Conjunction Voltage's max stack can be reached rather quickly despite its tendency to lose all its stacks upon expiry.
Because the reload speed bonus also applies to the time required to complete an Incarnon transformation, Voltage may be a good choice for Incarnon weapons that rapidly consume their Incarnon Charges, like the  Lato,  Kunai or the  Vasto.

Bugs
If installed in the secondary arcane slot of an Archgun equipped in the Heavy Weapon slot (on the third page of the Arsenal screen, below Gear and Emotes wheels), applying  Electricity status effects will cause the buff icon to appear even while that weapon is not equipped.
However, the effects are not applied to any weapon unless  Conjunction Voltage is installed in that weapon's active arcane slot.
